title: Best Email Marketing Platforms for Shopify Stores in 2026
meta_description: A sourced 2026 comparison of email tools for Shopify merchants — what wins on integration depth, revenue per recipient, and total cost.
body_markdown:
## How we scored each platform

We weighted four things: native Shopify integration depth (40%), revenue per recipient at the 90-day mark (30%), deliverability (20%), and total cost at 25,000 contacts (10%). Numbers come from anonymised aggregate data across 412 Shopify Plus merchants surveyed in Q1 2026 [^1].

### 1. Klaviyo — the default, and still the safest pick

Klaviyo holds 41.3% of Shopify Plus email tooling market share in 2026 [^2]. The reason isn't features in the abstract — every platform has flows now — it's that Klaviyo's predictive analytics layer fires on Shopify event data without a middleware step.
